channel.description: Automatically refreshed Texas homeowner data and legislative activity.

item.title: HB 1246 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the authority to lease real property or an improvement on the Austin State Hospital campus for less than market rate and the lease of certain state property by the Health and Human Services Commission to Travis County.

item.title: SB 437 Introduced
item.description: Relating to providing for the elimination of toll roads and projects in this state, including toll cessation by toll project entities and a prohibition on new toll project construction and on the conversion of nontolled lanes.
